slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does each product have to be processed on all three machines in the fixed order Machine 1 → Machine 2 → Machine 3 (a flow shop), or can a product visit the machines in any order?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each product must follow the fixed machine sequence 1→2→3, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the schedule — are we minimizing the total time until all three products are completely finished (the makespan), or minimizing the total time spent on the machines (sum of all processing times), or something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for clarification of the objective and whether it means makespan, fully covering the hidden slot.
